owner: CTO-1 Product Factory Architect + CI-1 Market Spy Chief + CISO / Security Judge
purpose: Identify what is missing before the AI robot factory can safely collect useful public internet information at scale.

gaps.gap: No enforced permission checklist before automated collection
gaps.risk: agents may collect from blocked or high-risk sources

gaps.gap: Source registry has seed sources but not enough verified domains
gaps.risk: competitor and lead intelligence remains unverified
gaps.fix: Grow source_registry.json to 20 verified sources with method/rate/risk/output

gaps.gap: No fetch queue / rate limiter implementation yet
gaps.risk: manual rules exist but are not technically enforced
gaps.fix: Build small local fetch queue with per-domain rate limits and robots/permission status field

gaps.gap: No provenance ledger for collected rows
gaps.risk: AI may use old, unverifiable or hallucinated data
gaps.fix: Every row gets source_url, collected_at, method, confidence and owner

gaps.gap: No duplicate detection across competitor, lead and marketplace data
gaps.risk: agents repeat work and pollute pipeline
gaps.fix: Add source hash, normalized domain, normalized company and data key

gaps.gap: No legal/privacy review trigger for personal data
gaps.risk: GDPR/privacy exposure when collecting contacts or profiles
gaps.fix: Mark personal-data fields and require CISO/Judge approval for high-risk collection

gaps.gap: No model prompt-injection isolation for scraped pages
gaps.risk: external pages can contain instructions that manipulate agents
gaps.fix: Treat fetched content as untrusted data and strip/quote before model processing

gaps.gap: No paid data provider CFO rule
gaps.risk: tool costs can exceed revenue before proof
gaps.fix: CFO approval required for paid SERP, proxy, data or enrichment tools

collection: Playwright only for public JS rendering

next_actions: Add task board P0 item for safe public-data crawler MVP.
Convert competitor verification queue into exact verified rows.
Replace seed leads with exact public companies only after permission checklist.
Connect collected data outputs to CEO Cockpit when JSON loading is ready.
